attchmntText: RACL Geartech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding financial results presentation for quarter ended September 30, 2026'.
voiceSummary: RACL Geartech Limited reported financial results for Q2 FY 2026-2027. Consolidated revenue for the quarter was 139.27 Crore, compared to 125.86 Crore in Q2 FY 25-26. Standalone revenue stood at 144.82 Crore, up from 122.84 Crore in the previous year. Consolidated EBITDA increased to 36.69 Crore from 31.74 Crore, while standalone EBITDA rose to 36.82 Crore from 31.58 Crore. Consolidated Profit Before Tax was 22.46 Crore, compared to 16.18 Crore previously. Standalone Profit Before Tax reached 22.61 Crore, up from 16.13 Crore. For the half-year, consolidated revenue grew to 271.87 Crore from 234.56 Crore. Standalone half-year revenue was 272.64 Crore, up from 230.8 Crore. Half-year consolidated EBITDA was 68.88 Crore versus 59.04 Crore. Half-year consolidated Profit Before Tax was 39.28 Crore, compared to 27.45 Crore.

attchmntText: RACL Geartech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: RACL Geartech Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting commenced at 11:00 A.M. and concluded at 03:20 P.M. Independent auditors Gupta Nayar & Co. issued review reports for both standalone and consolidated results. The auditors stated that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the financial statements prepared under Ind AS 34. The consolidated results include the wholly owned subsidiary RACL Geartech GmbH. The subsidiary's interim financial results were reviewed by management but not by its auditors. The subsidiary reported total assets of Rs. 18.58 Crores as at September 30, 2026. Total revenue for the subsidiary was Rs. 6.58 Crores for the quarter and Rs. 14.74 Crores for the period from April 1, 2026, to September 30, 2026. Net loss after tax was Rs. 0.22 Crores for the quarter and Rs. 0.09 Crores for the period. Net cash flow was Rs. 1.32 Crores for the period. The disclosure was uploaded on the company website.
